name: One-Time Passcodes
description: Spots verification codes as they arrive and shows them with a copy button and a countdown, so you never open the mail to read six digits.
author: Sarv

screenshots.caption: The code appears in the corner the moment the mail lands, with a copy button and a live countdown
Copying the code marks that message read, in whichever mailbox you are looking at

workflows.name: Detect one-time passcodes
workflows.description: Finds a verification code in the subject or body and surfaces it

settings.description: Surface one-time passcodes as they arrive
